name: LG 27GP950-B UltraGear
description: The LG 27GP950-B is a flagship 4K gaming monitor combining Nano IPS technology with a 160Hz refresh rate and 1ms GTG response. DisplayHDR 600 certification, HDMI 2.1 for console compatibility, and VESA DisplayHDR 600 make it a top-tier choice for next-gen gaming and professional color work.

name: ASUS ROG Swift PG279QM
description: The ASUS ROG Swift PG279QM pushes competitive gaming to the limit with a 240Hz Fast IPS panel that delivers 1ms response times at QHD resolution. G-SYNC Ultimate with VESA DisplayHDR 600, ROG SWIFT technology for near-zero motion blur, and a robust adjustable stand make it a premier esports display.

name: Dell UltraSharp U2722D
description: The Dell UltraSharp U2722D targets professionals with its IPS Black panel offering 2000:1 contrast ratio — twice that of standard IPS — and factory-calibrated Delta E < 2 color accuracy. USB-C with 90W power delivery, a built-in 4-port USB hub, and VESA ComfortView Plus make it the definitive workstation monitor.

name: Samsung Odyssey G7 32"
description: The Samsung Odyssey G7 features a dramatic 1000R curvature — matching the human eye's natural field of view — paired with a 240Hz VA panel and quantum dot technology. Its VESA DisplayHDR 600 certification and G-Sync/FreeSync Premium Pro compatibility deliver an immersive, competitive gaming experience.

name: BenQ PD3220U DesignVue
description: The BenQ PD3220U is purpose-built for designers and video editors with factory-calibrated Rec. 709, DCI-P3, and sRGB color modes, Thunderbolt 3 daisy-chaining, and a KVM switch for controlling two computers. Its 4K resolution and comprehensive port selection make it the hub of any professional creative workstation.

name: Alienware AW3423DWF
description: The Alienware AW3423DWF brings QD-OLED technology to ultrawide gaming with infinite contrast, 1.07 billion colors, and a blazing 165Hz refresh rate. Its 34-inch curved screen delivers cinematic immersion while FreeSync Premium Pro ensures buttery-smooth tear-free gaming without the G-SYNC premium.

name: ViewSonic VX2758-2KP-MHD
description: The ViewSonic VX2758-2KP-MHD offers exceptional value for budget-conscious gamers, delivering a 144Hz QHD IPS panel with AMD FreeSync Premium and 1ms GTG response at an accessible price point. Built-in speakers and flexible connectivity including DisplayPort and dual HDMI round out a compelling everyday gaming monitor.

name: ASUS ProArt PA278QV
description: The ASUS ProArt PA278QV delivers 100% sRGB and Rec. 709 coverage with a Delta E < 2 factory calibration for professional-grade color accuracy at an approachable price. The USB-C port, extensive pivot/tilt/swivel stand, and ProArt Calibration technology make it a versatile workhorse for designers and photographers.

name: MSI MPG Artymis 343CQR
description: The MSI MPG Artymis 343CQR combines a 165Hz ultrawide VA curved panel with Rapid VA technology for near-IPS response times. MSI's Night Vision technology intelligently adjusts dark scene brightness, while PIP/PBP support lets you multitask across multiple inputs on the expansive 34-inch display.

name: Philips Brilliance 279P1
description: The Philips Brilliance 279P1 is a feature-rich 4K USB-C business monitor with a 90W Power Delivery port, Windows Hello webcam with IR face recognition, and a built-in 4-port USB hub. Its LowBlue mode and adaptive contrast make it ideal for hybrid workers who spend long hours in front of a screen.
